paragraphs.text:
You break Bernard’s grip and throw him to the ground while 
Norman sees to Sylvia. You brace for a renewed  attack,  but 
instead,  Bernard  leaps  to  his  feet  and,  with  startling  haste, 
dashes for the river.

You check for any signs of a pulse or breathing. It’s true. 
As you stare at one murdered graduate student, you hear her 
attacker throw himself into the river. He does not emerge.

You bury Sylvia among the sand dunes. After you and Norman 
say a few words over her grave, you hurry away along the North 
Hanninah River. Neither of you speaks again until evening.
